method: Actual Poppler 110 dpi PNGs inspected via image viewer. All 15 pages inspected in contact sheets; invoice FR/AR, credit note and long pages 1,6,11,12 also inspected at original render size. Extraction and geometry tests are independent and do not replace visual inspection.

checks.name: French and mixed Arabic text legible; connected Arabic glyphs and natural Latin/Arabic run order
Arabic invoice RTL hierarchy, mirrored party/column order, natural LTR dates/addresses/amounts
No missing-glyph squares, clipping or overlapping text
Each three-row document includes totals, TVA, terms and public notes on one page
Long document has 68 lines, 15 note paragraphs, repeated table headings and 12 correctly numbered pages
A4 margins, section hierarchy, footer hashes and safe note page breaks reviewed

limits: Fictitious fixtures only: no issue, signature, DGI submission or database mutation.
Generic UBL 2.1 export; no PDF/A, qualified-signature or certified-DGI claim.
PDF readers differ in Arabic text extraction. Logical source lines are preserved through standard PDF ActualText spans in addition to valid embedded-font ToUnicode maps.
